fields.headline: THE TEAM SCRAMBLE.
fields.body: Not two against two. The whole team as one side, one ball, one card.

fields.headline:
ONE SIDE.
ONE BALL.
fields.body: Up to 4 players a side, every shot played from the best position of the one before it, until the ball is holed. One score a hole for the team.
The side plays off 25% of the lowest course handicap, 20% of the next, 15% of the third and 10% of the fourth, shots off the difference. 30/20/10 for a three, 35/15 for a two.

fields.headline:
EACH SIDE ENTERS
ITS OWN.
fields.body: Both teams put in their own gross and the hole stays pending until both are in. The draw sends the side out in fours, and a short side still plays.

fields.headline:
YOUR CUP.
LIVE.
fields.body: Free to build, pay to publish, free to play.
